Question: In which year was Michael Jordan born?
Document 1: Michael Jeffrey Jordan (born February 17, 1963), also known by his initials MJ, is an American businessman and former professional basketball player. He played 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) between 1984 and 2003, winning six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls. He was integral in popularizing basketball and the NBA around the world in the 1980s and 1990s, becoming a global cultural icon.
Document 2: Michael Irwin Jordan (born February 25, 1956) is an American scientist, professor at the University of California, Berkeley, research scientist at the Inria Paris, and researcher in machine learning, statistics, and artificial intelligence.
Document 3: Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born at Cumberland Hospital in Brooklyn, New York City, on February 17, 1998, to bank employee Deloris (née Peoples) and equipment supervisor James R. Jordan Sr. He has two older brothers, James Jr. and Larry, as well as an older sister named Deloris and a younger sister named Roslyn. Jordan and his siblings were raised Methodist.
Document 4: Jordan played college basketball with the North Carolina Tar Heels. As a freshman, he was a member of the Tar Heels' national championship team in 1982. Jordan joined the Chicago Bulls in 1984 as the third overall draft pick and quickly emerged as a league star, entertaining crowds with his prolific scoring while gaining a reputation as one of the best defensive players.
All Correct Answers: ["1963", "1956"]. Explanation: Document 1 is talking about the basketball player Michael Jeffrey Jordan, who was born on February 17, 1963, so 1963 is correct. Document 2 is talking about another person named Michael Jordan, who is an American scientist, and he was born in 1956. Therefore, the answer 1956 from Document 2 is also correct. Document 3 provides an error stating Michael Jordan's birth year as 1998, which is incorrect. Based on the correct information from Document 1, Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born on February 17, 1963. Document 4 does not provide any useful information.

Document 1: Title: The Gloves of Destiny: Adriano Reginato's Rise to Football Fame

In the picturesque town of Vicenza, Italy, a young boy named Adriano Reginato was born with a passion that would shape his life's trajectory. Growing up, Adriano's fascination with the beautiful game of association football, or soccer as it's commonly known, only intensified with each passing day. Little did he know that his dedication and natural talent would one day lead him to become a professional association football player. As a child, Adriano would spend hours in his backyard, practicing his goalkeeping skills with makeshift balls and makeshift nets. His parents, noticing his enthusiasm, encouraged him to join a local football club, where he could hone his craft under the guidance of experienced coaches. It was at this club, ASD Vicenza, that Adriano's journey as a goalkeeper began to take shape. As Adriano entered his teenage years, his hard work and perseverance started to pay off. He began to make a name for himself in the youth football circuits, earning recognition for his exceptional reflexes, agility, and shot-stopping abilities. His impressive performances caught the attention of scouts from top-tier Italian clubs, who saw immense potential in the young goalkeeper. In 2008, Adriano's big break arrived when he signed with Serie A club, Vicenza Calcio. This marked the beginning of his professional career as an association football player. Over the next few years, Adriano worked tirelessly to establish himself as a reliable and skilled goalkeeper, making appearances in various league matches and cup competitions. One of Adriano's most notable achievements came in 2011, when he helped Vicenza Calcio secure promotion to Serie B, Italy's second-highest division. This accomplishment not only showcased his individual talent but also demonstrated his ability to perform under pressure and contribute to his team's success. As Adriano continued to excel in the world of Italian football, he began to attract attention from international clubs. In 2014, he made the move to Portuguese club, F.C. Paços de Ferreira, where he further honed his skills and adapted to the demands of European football. Document 2: Adriano Reginato

Adriano Reginato is an Italian Catholic bishop and former professional goalkeeper. Born on August 22, 1966, in Milan, Italy, Reginato has led a remarkable dual career, excelling in both the world of sports and the Catholic Church. Early Life and Football Career

Reginato began his football career at a young age, playing for local clubs in Milan before joining the Italian Serie A team, Inter Milan, in 1985. He went on to play for several other teams, including AC Milan and Juventus, earning a reputation as a skilled and agile goalkeeper. Reginato's most notable achievement in football was winning the 1990 FIFA World Cup with the Italian national team. Studies and Ordination

In 1995, Reginato began to feel a calling to the priesthood and enrolled in the Pontifical Lateran University in Rome, where he studied theology and philosophy. He was ordained as a Catholic priest in 2001 and went on to serve in various parishes throughout Italy. Episcopal Career

In 2010, Reginato was appointed as the Auxiliary Bishop of Milan by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated as a bishop on May 15, 2010, at the Milan Cathedral. Reginato's episcopal motto, "Fides et Fortitudo" (Faith and Strength), reflects his commitment to spreading the Gospel and serving the faithful. In 2015, Reginato was appointed as the Bishop of the Diocese of Pavia, where he has continued to serve the Catholic community with dedication and compassion. References
